content.name: +2 Ammunition
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

This ammunition is typically found or sold in quantities of ten or twenty pieces. Ten pieces of this ammunition are equivalent in value to a potion of the same rarity {@note ({@table Magic Item Values by Rarity; Magic Item Rarities and Values|SRD52|2,000 GP})}.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
